empty.todo: Write down what you want done here; drag it to In progress to start someone on it, up and down to order it.
empty.waiting: What is done or failed waits here for you; drag it to Closed to complete or cancel it.
empty.closed: Completed and canceled tickets; drag one back to In progress to reopen it.

display.boardNote: The board always has a column per status, and dragging changes the status; grouping is for the list.
display.orderNote: Unless the order is Default, to-dos cannot be dragged up and down.
display.defaultNote: Default is the order you gave the to-dos.

page.pickFirst: Almost: pick which helper and which project, then press Start.
page.historyUnread: The tickets' records could not be read:
page.notFoundLine: There is no ticket {id}: it may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
page.find: Find a ticket: title, helper, project

acts.rejectWith: Send back, fix what is above

close.title: Close "{issue}"
close.working: {who} is still working on this ticket. Canceling stops it and lets it go; the changes on its branch are not merged into main.
close.completable: Completing merges {who}'s branch into the project's main branch, after you look over the changes; canceling lets it go without merging them.
close.notCompletable: This ticket cannot be completed now. Canceling lets {who} go, and its changes are not merged into main.

changes.none: This one has no changes. Completing just lets it go.
changes.conflict: Merging into {base} would conflict, so it cannot be completed yet
changes.resolveHow: Have it merge {base} into its own branch, resolve the conflicts, run the tests and commit; then complete it.
changes.behind: While it worked, {base} got {n} more commits; completing joins them (with one merge commit).
changes.uncommitted: {n} files are not committed yet; completing commits them first:
changes.moved: The ticket's status changed: go back to the ticket and see what it asks of you.

reopen.title: Reopen this ticket
reopen.line: A new helper of the same profile carries "{issue}" on; it will know what the ticket was for and how it was closed last time.
reopen.what: What to do this time (empty to finish what was left)

detail.rejectWhere: What did not pass, one per line
detail.tellWorking: It hears this even while it works
detail.tellIdle: Say something and it works another round
detail.noCriteria: {answer, select, true {This ticket has no criteria for done: judge by its answer when it comes back.} other {This ticket has no criteria for done: judge by its changes when it comes back.}}

result.unmet: It says this is not met

detail.orchestratorStuck: The manager did not finish answering this round: see what it said in its channel
detail.fromRecurrence: A schedule: each time it is due it goes to the manager, and its answer waits for you

task.label: Plan
task.waitsForYou: A step is waiting for you: open it to answer or review.
task.splitting: The manager is splitting it into steps; they will be listed below.
task.abandonLine: The steps not done yet are not sent out; the plan's branch stays, with every commit made so far.
task.reading: Looking at what the plan's branch changed…

todo.queued: Queued: every spot is taken, and it starts by itself when one frees up.
todo.refiningLine: It is reading the code, and will fill in the fields below.
todo.questions: {n, plural, one {The draft is written, and it has a question for you} other {The draft is written, and it has # questions for you}}
todo.questionsLine: Answer below, and it drafts again by your answers.
todo.draftedLine: Look it over, change what you like, and start it.
todo.whatLine: A line is enough: a helper reads the code and writes it up as a ticket.
todo.titleHint: Such as: add Remember me to the sign-in page
todo.title: Title
todo.descriptionHint: Description: why, what to do, what not to do, which files it may touch (drafting writes it)
todo.criteriaHint: One per line: the points you check when you review
todo.talk: Talk it through with the helper
todo.againHint: What to change when it drafts again (optional)
todo.whatHint: What should be done, in a line
todo.inQueue: Queued {ago}: it starts by itself in the board's order when a spot frees up.
todo.projectHint: The project's name, which is also its folder under the work folder

graph.draft: split: look it over, then start
graph.ready: all done, waiting for you to merge into main

run.heard: {n, plural, one {heard # word on the way} other {heard # words on the way}}

card.pickFirst: No helper or project picked: pick them before starting
card.waiting: waiting for a free spot, queued {ago}

issue.asking: {n, plural, one {{who} has a question for you} other {{who} has # questions for you}}
issue.askingLine: Pick an option to answer, or say it yourself.
issue.handedBack: {who} handed it back for you to review
issue.quiet: {who} has been quiet a long while
issue.quietLine: It may be running a long command, or it may be stuck: look at its steps, and stop it if it is wrong.
issue.reopenLine: To have it carry on, reopen it: write a line on what to do this time.
issue.inGraph: This is a step of a plan, and goes with the plan.
issue.splitting: Splitting the plan "{plan}": reading code only, changing no files.
issue.planStep: A step of the plan "{plan}": {step}. When done it merges into the plan's branch by itself, and reaches main when the whole plan does.
issue.stepsGone: Work steps are kept for 30 days (session.trajectory_days in the configuration); this ticket's are cleared.
